notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator – Patch 0.2.3
notes.content: [p]Another step forward in building your dream arcade! Patch [b]0.2.3[/b] brings new décor options, a brand-new shelf system for gachas, and a host of important fixes to make your arcade run smoother. This is the biggest update to the demo we've made so far. [/p][hr][/hr][h2]✨ Major Features[/h2][h3]🪩 Wall Décor – Lighting[/h3][p]Brighten up your arcade! You can now customize and add lighting décor to make your store stand out even more.[/p][h3]🗄️ Display Shelf System[/h3][p]Showcase your prized gachas! Players can now display gachas on shelves, and customers will buy directly from them when interested.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Minor Fixes & Improvements[/h2][p][b]Tutorial & UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed tutorial arrow not working properly for [b]Buy & Unlock Ninja Fighter[/b] and [b]Gacha Ball[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial overlapping on the [b]Pause Menu[/b] resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Mini-Game Instructions[/b] throughout the game (including end-of-day repair mini-game).[/p][/*][*][p]Move hover graphics to a layer below tablet apps.[/p][/*][*][p]Furniture App description now uses a plain font and includes proper product screen layout.[/p][/*][*][p]Added descriptions for machines and furniture.[/p][/*][*][p]Store name now appears in the [b]Reviews App[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Balance on [b]Purchase Screen[/b] now updates correctly (previously showed 000).[/p][/*][*][p]Purchase screen shopping label made a [b]universal size[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]purchase screen negative balance[/b]: now shows [b]red text with “–” sign[/b] instead of brackets.[/p][/*][*][p]Options menu now has proper [b]SFX button clicks[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Pricing App (16:10) alignment fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]price change arrows[/b] to the Pricing App and Set Price window.[/p][/*][*][p]Pricing screen now shows [b]gacha elements[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Furniture App alignment adjusted and [b]vertical scroll bar[/b] added.[/p][/*][*][p]Customisation screen text (walls & floors) is now [b]white[/b], with reduced button UI text size.[/p][/*][*][p]Walls & Floors customization now support [b]horizontal scroll wheel[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Delivery notification properly aligned for [b]16:10 aspect ratio[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Display shelf description text fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Display shelf slot highlight is no longer visible from far away.[/p][/*][*][p]Gacha thumbnail resize fixed in Set Price window.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Neon Light[/b] price updated to 100.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Display Shelf[/b] price updated to 200.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]NPCs will not interact with a machine while the player is using it (e.g., gacha).[/p][/*][*][p]Customers waiting in line now leave after an hour instead of standing forever.[/p][/*][*][p]Customers will now [b]wait until repairs are finished[/b] before lining up again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where too many dissatisfied customers appeared.[/p][/*][*][p]If player has 2 counter tables, Redemption UI now works correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Redemption zoom bug (camera zooms into monitor when inserting tickets) [b]"Items bought by customer"[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Systems & Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Dynamic Prices[/b] for all machines via City Layout Scene_Manager_MarketPrices.[/p][/*][*][p]Progressive unlock system for Furniture App items.[/p][/*][*][p]Online Shop:[/p][list][*][p]Shipping will no longer auto-select the first option on first notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator Demo – Patch v0.2.2
notes.content:
[p]Hey Arcade Managers![/p][p]We’re back with [b]Patch v0.2.2[/b], building on the repair and customization features introduced last update — plus tons of polish and community-requested bug fixes.[/p][p]Let’s dive into what’s new![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ [b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🧩 [b]New Repair Mini-Game[/b]
One more way to keep your arcade machines in top shape! Enjoy a fresh new interactive repair mechanic that keeps maintenance fun and engaging.[/p][/*][*][p]🏠 [b]Store Customization (Floors & Walls)[/b]
Give your arcade its own personality! You can now customize the [b]floor and wall styles[/b] to match your vibe and create the perfect arcade ambiance.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧰 Minor Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]✨ [b]Added Repair Particle Effects[/b] to make repairs feel more satisfying.[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Mini-Game SFX[/b] — Repair and cleaning mini-games now come with sound effects for a better feel.[/p][/*][*][p]🧽 [b]Updated Model for Cleaning Mini-Game[/b] for a cleaner, more polished experience.[/p][/*][*][p]📋 [b]Instructions for Mini-Games[/b] have been added to help players understand what to do.[/p][/*][*][p]🎟️ [b]Redemption UI Fix[/b] — If you have two counter tables, the UI now correctly appears and functions.[/p][/*][*][p]🛑 [b]Box Pickup Movement Bug[/b] — Fixed issue where picking up boxes moved the player unexpectedly.[/p][/*][*][p]🔁 [b]Repair Progress Saving[/b] — Your repair progress now saves properly, even between sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]🧍‍♂️ [b]Customers Standing at Removed Counters[/b] — Customers now stop visiting counters that have been removed. No more ghosts![/p][/*][*][p]🍹 [b]SFX Added for Soda Refilling[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🖱️ Fixed [b]Tutorial UI from the Purchase Screen[/b] behaving incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]🔍 Fixed a [b]ticket counter zoom-in bug[/b] on Day 2 where clicking would result in a strange close-up.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 Coming in Patch 0.2.3[/h3][p]Here’s what’s on the way next:[/p][list][*][p]🖼️ [b]Wall Décor[/b]: Add posters, lighting, and more decorative elements.[/p][/*][*][p]🕹️ [b]Support for More Machine Types[/b]: Car racing, dance machines, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]🤝 [b]2-Player Machine Support[/b]: Including Air Hockey and 2P arcade cabinets.[/p][/*][*][p]🚧 [b]Fix for Counter Table Clipping Through Walls[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for all your feedback — every message and bug report helps shape the game into the ultimate arcade sim. Stay tuned for more fun soon![/p][p]👉 [b]Join our community on Discord:[/b]
🔗 [url="https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx"]https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx[/url][/p][p]See you in the next update! 💥[/p]

notes.title: 🕹️ Arcade Management Simulator Demo – Patch v0.2.0
notes.content:
[h3]🎉 First Major Feature Update![/h3][p]Hey Arcade Managers![/p][p]We're excited to roll out [b]Patch v0.2.0[/b], the [b]first major feature update[/b] for Arcade Management Simulator! This update marks a big step forward — laying the foundation for deeper mechanics, smarter systems, and a more rewarding player experience.[/p][p]From financial control through loans, to a fully reworked retail and shipping system, this patch opens up new ways to grow, customize, and fine-tune your arcade empire. Let's dive in![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 Major New Features[/h3][list][*][p]🏦 [b]Bank Loan App[/b]
Need a cash boost? Take out [b]loans from the bank[/b] to upgrade, expand, and dominate faster. But be careful — interest adds up![/p][/*][*][p]🌟 [b]Customer Reviews System[/b]
Your arcade is now under the spotlight! Customers leave [b]reviews[/b] that influence foot traffic — better service = more customers!
Check out all the feedback in the new [b]Reviews App[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]📦 [b]Advanced Shipping System[/b]
The online shop now features [b]three shipping options[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Instant Delivery[/b] (costly but immediate)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Regular Delivery[/b] (balanced)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Next Day Free Delivery[/b] (budget-friendly, but delayed)
This adds a strategic layer to inventory planning and arcade stocking.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧰 Minor Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]🖥️ Fixed [b]online shop UI[/b] scaling on different resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]🚶‍♂️ [b]NPC Walking Animation Fix[/b][/p][/*][*][p]⚖️ [b]Rebalanced machine and item pricing[/b] to feel more realistic.[/p][/*][*][p]🗑️ Fixed [b]hover glyphs[/b] not showing above regular trash cans.[/p][/*][*][p]🧾 [b]Pricing app[/b] now stays open unless intentionally closed — clicking inside won’t auto-close it.[/p][/*][*][p]🕒 Fixed issue where if you redeemed tickets right before a customer leaves, the [b]next customer’s pointer glitched[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🎁 Redemption [b]prize numbers now round off correctly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🥤 Updated [b]refill dialogue[/b] for the soda machine to be clearer.[/p][/*][*][p]🗑️ You can no longer [b]set prices on regular trash cans[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ Fixed [b]coin collection stutter[/b] due to performance hiccups.[/p][/*][*][p]🧲 Reduced [b]physics knockback[/b] caused by cola cans pushing the player.[/p][/*][*][p]🎲 Removed [b]small cube markers[/b] from in front of Gacha machines.[/p][/*][*][p]🖼️ Gacha ball display in [b]16:10 aspect ratio[/b] now renders correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]🎯 Gacha machines stacked on top of each other now [b]fill correctly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🧭 Tutorial pointer is now [b]disabled[/b] when the tablet is closed or the player is not in the redemption screen.[/p][/*][*][p]🛒 [b]Tutorial[/b] [b]Purchase pointer[/b] now consistently appears where it should.[/p][/*][*][p]📱 If the [b]tablet is open during end-of-day[/b], pressing enter now [b]closes it properly[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]📚 Fixed [b]broken Gacha opening tutorial[/b] flow (Open → Add to Collection → View → Close).[/p][/*][*][p]⏹️ While viewing a Gacha model in the collection app, pressing [b]Escape now exits the viewer and app properly[/b], instead of opening the pause menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented the same [b]NPC[/b] model visiting the store multiple times.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 What’s Next?[/h3][p]Patch 0.2.0 is just the beginning of the [b]feature phase[/b] of development. notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator – Demo Patch v0.1.5
notes.content:
[p]Hey Arcade Owners![/p][p]We’re thrilled to bring you [b]Patch v0.1.5[/b], a significant quality-of-life update that smooths out gameplay, fixes bugs, and improves core systems — all based on your awesome feedback.[/p][p]Thank you for continuing to support us and helping shape the future of [b]Arcade Management Simulator[/b]. We’re just warming up, and the next update will be our [b]first major feature drop[/b], but more on that at the end![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Major Fixes & Changes[/h3][list][*][p]⏳ [b]Redemption Queue Timeout[/b]
Customers waiting [b]more than 1 hour[/b] at the redemption counter will now [b]leave the queue[/b], and you’ll earn [b]reduced XP[/b] for delayed service.[/p][/*][*][p]📦 [b]Sell Machines / Box Up Feature Added[/b]
You can now [b]box up or sell machines[/b] directly from your arcade — time to declutter and earn back some cash![/p][/*][*][p]🎓 [b]Gacha Tutorial Moved to Day 1[/b]
The Gacha tutorial now triggers [b]after[/b] the ticket and coin collection tutorial — for a smoother learning flow.[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ [b]Settings Menu Bug Fixed[/b]
Changing settings now [b]properly applies changes across all game systems[/b]. Your preferences will stick as expected![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧰 Minor Fixes & Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]🕹️ Updated tutorial to instruct players to go to the [b]machine with the exclamation mark[/b] (Ninja Fighter).[/p][/*][*][p]🚶‍♂️ Increased [b]walking speed[/b] to [b]6[/b] for faster arcade navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]🪟 Fixed issue where [b]Gacha machines appeared transparent[/b] when viewed from outside the arcade.[/p][/*][*][p]📱 [b]Tablet apps enabled[/b] with proper overlays now active.[/p][/*][*][p]🏷️ Increased [b]sticker size[/b] on refill boxes. Changed quantity display format to: [b]8/15[/b]. Switched color to [b]black[/b] for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p]🥷 Ninja Fighter machine now starts at [b]70% full[/b] on Day 1.[/p][/*][*][p]❌ Replaced “Collect them all” prompt in Gacha with a new prompt: [b]"Press ESC to leave the Gacha Machine."[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🖱️ Added tooltip: [b]"Click and hold left click inside the green highlight to collect coins from the Gacha Machine."[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🖱️ Fixed bug where the [b]mouse pointer disappeared[/b] if you were at the redemption counter and the day ended. It now stays visible.[/p][/*][*][p]💚 Adjusted [b]green coin highlight[/b] to avoid overlapping with Gacha characters (based on your video feedback).[/p][/*][*][p]🚪 Fixed issue where [b]customers walked through closed doors[/b] after redeeming tickets post-day-end.[/p][/*][*][p]🗑️ [b]Trash bin[/b] can no longer be placed or moved while in the redemption screen.[/p][/*][*][p]🗑️ Fixed bug where selecting [b]Q[/b] on the trash bin [b]duplicated it in multiple places[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 Coming Soon: First Feature Update[/h3][p]Get ready — our next major update will introduce [b]new gameplay systems[/b] and deeper arcade management tools. Here's what to expect in [b]Patch v0.2.0[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]🏪 [b]Retail System Revamp[/b] – Overhauled backend for smoother store operations.[/p][/*][*][p]🏦 [b]Bank Loan App[/b] – Take loans to expand your arcade empire.[/p][/*][*][p]🌟 [b]Customer Reviews System[/b] – Hear what players love (and hate) about your arcade.[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Machine Repair System[/b] – Fix up broken machines to avoid downtime.[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Store Customization[/b] – Personalize your arcade with [b]flooring and wall options[/b]![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you again for being part of this journey. Your feedback continues to shape the game and push it forward. We’re just getting started — and the best is yet to come![/p][p]👉 [b]Join our official Discord community[/b] to share your ideas, report bugs, and hang out with fellow arcade enthusiasts:
🔗 [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx"]https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Until next time — keep managing and keep playing! 🕹️[/p][hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🎮 Arcade Management Simulator Demo - Update v0.1.3
notes.content:
[p]Hey Arcade Managers![/p][p]We’re back with a [b]major update (v0.1.3)[/b] packed with important fixes and new features — and we want to start by saying [b]thank you[/b] for the incredible support you’ve shown us, especially during [b]last week’s Steam Next Fest[/b]. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re excited to keep building this game with you![/p][p]This update focuses on improving game stability, adding a long-requested [b]Settings Menu[/b], and fixing several issues related to saving, UI scaling, machine behavior, and more.[/p][h3]🛠️ Patch Notes – Demo v0.1.3[/h3][list][*][p]🖥️ [b]Dynamic UI Scaling[/b]
The UI now automatically adjusts to your screen resolution, improving playability across devices.[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ [b]New Settings Menu Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjust screen [b]resolution[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Change [b]music and SFX volumes[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Tweak [b]mouse sensitivity[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]💡 [b]Coin Box Highlights[/b]
Always-on coin box highlights for [b]Samurai Legend[/b], [b]Robot Revolt[/b], and [b]Dungeon Quest[/b] have been disabled for better visual clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]❗ [b]Machine Exclamation Issue Fixed[/b]
Exclamation icons now persist correctly across days and saves — no more disappearing alerts on full machines.[/p][/*][*][p]🕘 [b]Post-9PM Save Bug Fixed[/b]
Saving the game after 9PM and reloading no longer prevents progression — the end-of-day sequence now triggers correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]💳 [b]Billing System Fixed[/b]
Billing logic has been corrected to reflect accurate financial tracking and deductions.[/p][/*][*][p]🎰 [b]Faster Gacha Animation[/b]
Gacha opening animations are now faster and snappier for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][*][p]🧹 [b]Proper Game Reset[/b]
The game now resets all states correctly when starting a new session, ensuring a clean slate each time.[/p][/*][*][p]🧱 [b]Object Placement Issue in Tutorial Fixed[/b]
You can now move and place objects freely after the tutorial, even outside the highlighted area.[/p][/*][*][p]🕔 [b]Store Status Bug Fixed[/b]
After saving and reloading, the store status now reflects properly (no more “Closed” signs with active customers).[/p][/*][*][p]💸 [b]Machine Prices Now Save Correctly[/b]
Pricing for machines will persist properly across sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]📊 [b]Daily Report Stats Fixed[/b]
Daily report data now displays and calculates correctly after saving and continuing.[/p][/*][*][p]🎵 [b]Music Volume Fix[/b]
Music now maintains your set volume even after exiting the pause or settings menu — no more unexpected volume jumps![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 Coming Soon in the Next Update[/h3][p]We're already working on the next update! Here's what to expect:[/p][list][*][p]🔁 [b]Gacha Replication Bug Fix[/b]
Gacha machines placed on top rows will save and function properly.[/p][/*][*][p]🧩 [b]Gacha Placement Improvements[/b]
Gachas set on elevated rows will be movable without issues.[/p][/*][*][p]🏪 [b]Retail Store Expansion Revamp[/b]
We’re laying the groundwork for a [b]revamped store system[/b] and a brand-new [b]customization menu[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you again for being part of this amazing journey. We’re just getting started — and we’ve got some [b]exciting features and surprises[/b] lined up for the future. 🚀[/p][p]👉 [b]Join our official Discord to share your feedback, get sneak peeks, and connect with other players:[/b]
🔗 [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx"]https://discord.gg/t96r3WKvhx[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Let’s keep building the ultimate arcade together! 🕹️[/p]
